profileLabel: Center-left economics (low confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Rizal 1st District representative with 6 principal-authored bills. Authored a mining-free Rizal, a teaching allowance for private school teachers (two bills), a young farmers and fisherfolk challenge program and a local government people's council partnership system. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Very small portfolio; economic score rests on three modest bills. Bill-based only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a mining-free zone for Rizal (-2) and a teaching allowance for private teachers (-2); co-authored national minimum wage (-2). Three issues, very small portfolio.
